name: Zerobyte
author: nicotsx
description: Zerobyte automates encrypted backups of locally mounted directories using Restic, with scheduling, retention policies, monitoring, and local or cloud storage destinations.

form_fields.label: Zerobyte App Secret
form_fields.hint: Generated encryption secret. Keep it unchanged and save it with your backups.

form_fields.label: Zerobyte Base URL
form_fields.hint: Exact URL used to open Zerobyte: http://<server-ip>:8929 or https://<your-domain>.
